sn45.4:3.1: “Sir, this morning I robed up and, taking my bowl and robe, entered Sāvatthī for alms.
sn45.4:3.2: I saw, sir, the brahmin Jānussoṇi driving out of Sāvatthī in an all-white chariot drawn by mares.
sn45.4:3.3: The yoked horses were pure white, as were the ornaments, chariot, upholstery, reins, goad, and canopy. And his turban, robes, sandals were white, as was the chowry fanning him.
